qualification:
First-entry pair with a shared688-byte comparison choice and exact arguments.
Both calls must read the same original proof allocation and every candidate
coordinate from the common typed encoder reply. Actual comparison semantics
come from the separately checked native-SDK gate/reference theorem; this cut
does not assert that arbitrary bytes compare equal. All other libc comparisons
retain their original body. Actual source/cut congruence still must compose.
domain: All original fixed-length proof/public/checkpoint allocations, metadata, instruction/account counts0..3, independent arbitrary data/lamport aliases, signed counters and nonzero Rc fields. Unseeded proof/candidate independent. Both complete native/reference first wrappers execute; common typed successful child replies, first reply empty. Parent native frame must be enforced before original buffers are reused. No initialization/image assumption.
remaining: Actual source scan and installed child substitution, full successful first-output/writeback continuation and arbitrary runtime heap/ABI/oracle transport. Ordinary SDK model contextual substitution consumes the direct coupling plus unary frames, not just codegen. No full native/S2 closure.
comparison_cut: Only C memcmp calls of length688 route to the retained extern-C Rust observer. It checks original proof pointer, exact candidate byte at arbitrary index0..687 and ordered child prefix for both phases; a common read-only Boolean choice determines0/nonzero. All other comparisons forward original memcmp. This is a relational cut; actual value semantics and source/cut transport remain required, not an assertion of prefix equality.
